dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The five most prominent 'O' shaped structures exhibit irregular, crenulated outer perimeters. The gradient transition from the dark background (exterior) to the lighter pigment of the ring (interior) is characterized by a sharp, high-contrast boundary of 2-4 pixels in width, while the transition from the ring back into the dark central core is more diffused.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a moderate density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated in the anterior dorsal region. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as asymmetrical, punctate dots interspersed between the larger macro-annuli structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Connecting the centroids of the three largest centrally located macro-annuli forms an obtuse triangle. This triangle is part of a larger irregular pentagonal configuration when including the centroids of the two adjacent smaller annuli located towards the posterior-dorsal region.
